name: Idol (Speridlabs open image-to-3D Gaussian splat model)
summary: Open 600M-parameter 3D-DiT that turns a single image of an object into a complete 3D Gaussian splat (up to ~1M Gaussians, standard 3DGS .ply), including unseen sides. Runs on consumer NVIDIA GPUs (~7.2 GB VRAM, about 2-3 s per object). Weights, inference SDK and a Hugging Face demo are released under Apache-2.0.

access.notes: Idol weights/code Apache-2.0. Needs gated DINOv3 and FLUX.2-dev VAE on HF: free HF account + accepting their terms; those encoders carry their own licenses. NVIDIA CUDA GPU required.

procedure: Create a free Hugging Face account and accept the terms of facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m and black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev, then run `hf auth login`.
git clone https://github.com/speridlabs/idol-sdk && cd idol-sdk && pip install -e . (Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.5+, CUDA GPU).
Run `python -m idol.sample --image photo.jpg --mode real`; weights (~3 GB) download automatically from huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol.
Open the output .ply in any Gaussian splat viewer, or try the browser demo at huggingface.co/spaces/speridlabs/idol.

verdict.why: Official open-weights image-to-3D splat model from the publisher, Apache-2.0, consumer-GPU friendly, strong launch traction (~1.2k likes, 88 GitHub stars in a day). Caveat: depends on gated third-party encoders.
